      Abstract
I will provide a historical perspective on wait-free simulations of multi-bit shared registers using
single-bit shared registers, starting with classical results from the last century and ending with
an overview of the recent resurgence of interest in the topic. Particular emphasis will be placed
on the space and step complexities of such simulations.
